recent_articles.title: I survived a missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz, but my friend has not been found
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A missile strike on the oil tanker Skylight in the Strait of Hormuz killed **Dalip Rathore**, 25, and injured others.  The attack, which occurred on March 1st, was the first commercial vessel to be struck after the US-Israel war with Iran erupted. The ship's owner, Red Sea Ship Management, based in Dubai, is unidentifiable and unresponsive to inquiries. **Sunil Puniya**, 26, a crew member on the Skylight, lost his friend and remains traumatized by the experience.  The incident highlights the growing dangers faced by seafarers in the Strait of Hormuz due to geopolitical conflicts, with many vessels stranded and facing abandonment by their shipowners. The International Transport Workers' Federation (ITF) reports a surge in abandoned seafarers, highlighting the need for improved maritime regulations and accountability.

The policy aims to boost the state's economy to $350 billion by 2028-29.  The Cabinet also approved decisions on energy production, water conservation, and pensioners' welfare.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.P. recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Govt claims women winning unreserved panchayat seats in ‘significant numbers’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Government** celebrated National Panchayati Raj Day, highlighting the progress of women's reservation in Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).  While the Constitution mandates a 33% quota for women in urban and rural local bodies, 19 states have extended this provision to reserve 50% seats for women. However, data shows that the actual number of women representatives exceeds the prescribed quota in only 10 states/union territories, while four others fail to meet it.  The Ministry emphasized the increasing representation of women in PRIs, but acknowledged discrepancies between mandated and achieved quotas across various states.
